scope: Reviewed additive patch-version API and native source manifest changes; not platform/package/release certification.
snapshotEncoding: UTF-8 without BOM, invariant LF, final newline
reviewedBoundaries: standard ports expose neutral immutable contracts
frontend has only one frontend and three explicitly advanced worker types
internal implementation APIs are delivered in the SDK but are not extra products
consumer compilation and MSBuild integration absent
worker provisioning uses only deployed verified resources
snapshotFacts: native function-pointer signatures and calling conventions
limitations: Not a universal nullable-annotation or custom-attribute compatibility analyzer; review contract/source semantics separately.
reviewedPreReleaseChanges: Retire all consumer compilation, native build/provider/packaging APIs and MSBuild integration without compatibility aliases; consumers own compilation, linking and deployment.
Remove TargetConfiguration.toolchain, an unused auto-only alias; explicit targets.settings retains parser SDK paths, macros and arguments.

WorkerAssetProvisioner.Prepare verifies application-deployed standard NuGet content and exact host-native resources before preparing or reusing an owned version/host/manifest resource directory; no download, compiler execution, global NuGet lookup or build hook.

The independent Contracts/Runtime, neutral transformation ports and C/C++ bridge emitters retain their current documented contracts. Unsupported ABI forms and missing lifecycle evidence remain strict failures or omit only the unsafe friendly projection.
reviewedPatchChanges: Add typed portable NativeSourceManifest input roots, files, ordered include requirements and generated sources; return physical root bindings separately from portable JSON.
Add BindingArtifactManifest.ReadNativeSources and a locked verified publication callback; no build or execution services enter Contracts.
Add optional BindingDiagnostic.details and parserBuiltinInputs for bounded failure context and exact resource separation.
Add compiler-declared per-field storageSize/storageEvidence independently of reference referent sizeof; strict graph/layout checks remain.
Contracts major 3 and existing extension ports remain; API minor 1 identifies the additive surface. v3.0.0 remains immutable.
